author: Steve Kuckuk
text: Regarding "loss of signal" . . . My experience suggests Bluetooth can be/is an imperfect technology . . . (Remember the Libre App needs to be open to work) It is typical that the connection can be lost from time to time particularly if the phone (or reader) is sitting somewhere as you travel from room to room . . . Having too many  devices connected, or overuse of heavy data apps can also impact connectivity . . . In general it will correct itself and reestablish the communication between devices by itself usually in minutes, sometimes longer . . . Powering down the phone (or reader)  and starting it up again, or turning off and on the Bluetooth are  really the only diagnostics I know of, short deleting and reinstalling the App itself  . . .  It should be noted that when the connection is restored, the missed data from the sensor transfers to the phone, meaning no actual data is lost. .
